hypothesis: Clarify that all supplied D documents must be checked independently of main-question relevance.

revision.before: Check D-numbered documents against the current question, corroborating material, and medical knowledge; do not infer truth from repeated wording or an assigned label. A false detail unrelated to the main question does not reverse an otherwise supported main answer.
revision.after: Check every supplied D-numbered document for factual errors using corroborating material and medical knowledge, and report errors even when they are unrelated to the main question; do not infer truth from repeated wording or an assigned label. Decide the main answer from relevant, factually supported information, without letting an unrelated error overturn it.

scope: All frozen pilot M22 inputs; exposed v5 development; no correctness-based selection.
controls: Both arms newly generated on both original backbones; full original messages/schema/decoding retained; adjacent item pairs with alternating arm order.
reporting: Eight units: reference/variant/both/valid-invariance; 48 records: repairs/harms; independent document detection valid/exact/TP/FP/FN; token/time costs.
limits: Document-ID detection does not score correction-text meaning. Same questions and noisy variants are not independent clinical cases. No further prompt search.
